name: Hagar Lightninghoof
summary: At Freewind Post, Hagar Lightninghoof investigates rumors of an unusual egg hidden deep in the canyon. Wind serpents guard it fiercely, and he wants to learn what lies within.

sections.title: The Strange Clutch
sections.body: Hagar Lightninghoof hears reports of an unnatural egg in a cavern below Freewind Post. Wind serpents guard the nest with unusual ferocity, keeping curious scouts away. So Hagar seeks an adventurer bold enough to brave their den and bring back the egg. He hopes to study it firsthand and learn what creature inspires such fierce protection from the canyon’s natural predators.

sections.title: A Myth Hatched
sections.body: The egg reaches Freewind Post and hatches before Hagar Lightninghoof. A young wind serpent emerges, resembling Arikara, the revered spirit of vengeance in tauren folklore. Hagar recognizes the creature’s weight in tauren culture and spiritual life. Then he sends the traveler to consult the elder Motega Firemane.

faq.answer: Hagar Lightninghoof is a tauren scout at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles. He investigates reports of unusual wildlife, including an egg deep in a nearby cavern.

faq.q: Where can Hagar Lightninghoof be found?
faq.answer: Hagar Lightninghoof can be found atop Freewind Post, the central Horde outpost perched on the massive rock needles of central Thousand Needles.

faq.q: What is the 'alien egg' Hagar is looking for?
faq.answer: The alien egg is an unusual egg guarded by wind serpents in a cavern below. Hagar asks an adventurer to retrieve it so he can study it.

faq.q: Who does Hagar consult about the egg?
aliases: who do i turn serpent wild into
faq.answer: Hagar sends the adventurer to speak with Motega Firemane, an elder at Freewind Post with deeper wisdom about tauren traditions.

angles.text: As a tauren, helping Hagar brings an ancient legend into the present: Arikara, the winged embodiment of vengeance, lives in the canyons below.
As a Horde warrior, you can help Hagar reach perilous dens that ordinary scouts cannot safely enter.
